lines.text: You must return your brother's lost animals and belongings, and help lift his fallen donkey or ox.
You must let the mother bird go, take only the young, and put a railing around your new roof.
A husband says his wife was no virgin, but her parents bring proof to the priests and he is punished.
Only the man who overpowers and lies with a betrothed woman in the field must die; she cried out.
Caught with an unpledged virgin, a man pays her father fifty shekels; no man may marry his uncle's wife.
